protocol: 520 authored scenarios, split 216 development / 104 diagnostic validation / 40 fresh calibration / 160 frozen final test. Perturbations are dependent checks, not independent scenarios. Parameters and prompts were frozen before final inference. No final-test tuning.

uncertainty.limitation: This nominal bound assumes independent representative Bernoulli trials. Authored family-related scenarios do not establish that assumption or a production error rate. Confidence is model self-assessment, not a calibrated success probability.
